approval.rationale: Dark, rock-faced granite blocks in level courses of varied height with narrow recessed dark joints, evenly sooted by rain and smoke: it reads as a grim castle wall at every gameplay camera and tiles every 3 m without a visible grid. Verified in game on the Royal Citadel and the Old Fort, including through the sightline cutaway.
limitations: One course of notched, irregular blocks repeats every 3 m; on long curtains it can read as a faint horizontal band.
The faces carry Qwen's baked top-left relief shading, so the blocks look lit from the upper left whatever the sun does.
Uniform tone: no water staining below the battlements, no moss line at the plinth, no repairs in other stone.
